name: gravityforms
description: Gravity Forms driver for the WordPress payment processing library.

scripts.start: wp-env start && npm run setup && npm run login
scripts.setup-language-core: wp-env run cli wp language core install nl_NL --activate
scripts.setup-language-plugins: wp-env run cli wp language plugin install --all nl_NL
scripts.setup-language-themes: wp-env run cli wp language theme install --all nl_NL
scripts.setup-gravityforms: wp-env run cli wp config set GF_LICENSE_KEY $GRAVITYFORMS_LICENSE_KEY
scripts.setup-mollie: wp-env run cli wp config set MOLLIE_API_KEY $MOLLIE_API_KEY
scripts.setup-buckaroo-website-key: wp-env run cli wp config set BUCKAROO_WEBSITE_KEY $BUCKAROO_WEBSITE_KEY
scripts.setup-buckaroo-secret-key: wp-env run cli wp config set BUCKAROO_SECRET_KEY $BUCKAROO_SECRET_KEY
scripts.login: wp-env run cli wp user one-time-login admin
